payload.description: Bots become organization-owned: Bot drops its user scope and name uniqueness moves from (tenant, user, name) to (tenant, name), because an organization has one named teammate, not one per employee. Channels lose their single owner: ChannelParticipant already models multi-actor membership, so the change is the roster index at messaging/store.py, which keys channels by channel.user_id and becomes one roster item per human participant. Computer drops user_id and becomes organization-wide, keeping the property that one bot continues from files another bot saved.
payload.title: Shared channels and organization-owned bots
